"""
Project Title: Neural ODE + Transformer for Time-Series Forecasting (ai-ml-ds-NeuralODETrans2025)
File Name: neural_ode_transformer_timeseries.py

Short Description:
Combines a Neural ODE encoder with a Transformer decoder to forecast irregular time-series.
Learns continuous dynamics via ODE-RNN and performs multi-step prediction with attention.
Uses PhysioNet irregular heart-rate dataset loaded via tfds.
"""

import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds  # type: ignore

# Hyperparameters
DIM_H: int = 64
ODE_STEPS: int = 5
TRANS_LAYERS: int = 4
TRANS_HEADS: int = 4
MLP_DIM: int = 128
LR: float = 1e-3
BATCH: int = 32
EPOCHS: int = 50
PRED_STEPS: int = 10

# Neural ODE component
class ODECell(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.dense = layers.Dense(DIM_H, activation="tanh")
    def call(self, t, h):
        return self.dense(h)

def ode_rnn_encode(times, values):
    batch: tf.Tensor = values
    h = tf.zeros((tf.shape(batch)[0], DIM_H))
    for i in range(values.shape[1]):
        t0 = times[:, i:i+1]
        t1 = times[:, i+1:i+2] if i + 1 < values.shape[1] else t0
        dt = t1 - t0
        for _ in range(ODE_STEPS):
            h = h + dt * ODECell()(None, h)
        h = layers.Dense(DIM_H, activation="relu")(tf.concat([h, values[:, i]], -1))
    return h

# Transformer decoder
def build_transformer_decoder():
    inp = Input((PRED_STEPS, DIM_H))
    x = inp
    for _ in range(TRANS_LAYERS):
        x1 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
        att = layers.MultiHeadAttention(TRANS_HEADS, DIM_H//TRANS_HEADS)(x1, x1)
        x = x + att
        x2 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
        mlp = layers.Dense(MLP_DIM, activation="gelu")(x2)
        mlp = layers.Dense(DIM_H)(mlp)
        x = x + mlp
    out = layers.Dense(1)(x)
    return Model(inp, out)

transformer_decoder = build_transformer_decoder()
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)
mse = tf.keras.losses.MeanSquaredError()

# Data loader
ds = tfds.load("physionet_sepsis", split="train", as_supervised=False)
def prep(batch):
    times = batch["time"][:100]
    vals = tf.expand_dims(batch["heartrate"][:100], -1)
    next_times = times[-PRED_STEPS:]
    return (times[None, :-PRED_STEPS], vals[None, :-PRED_STEPS]), vals[None, -PRED_STEPS:]
ds = ds.map(prep).batch(BATCH)

# Training
@tf.function
def step(inp, target):
    (times, vals), ytrue = inp, target
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        h = ode_rnn_encode(times, vals)
        hflat = tf.expand_dims(h, 1) + tf.zeros((BATCH, PRED_STEPS, DIM_H))
        ypred = transformer_decoder(hflat)
        loss = mse(ytrue, ypred)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, transformer_decoder.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, transformer_decoder.trainable_variables))
    return loss

for ep in range(EPOCHS):
    for batch in ds:
        loss = step(batch[0], batch[1])
    tf.print("Epoch", ep, "Loss", loss)

# Example use case
(times, vals), y = next(iter(ds))
h = ode_rnn_encode(times, vals)
yp = transformer_decoder(tf.expand_dims(h, 1) + tf.zeros((1,PRED_STEPS,DIM_H)))
print("True:", y.numpy()[0,:,0], "\nPred:", yp.numpy()[0,:,0])

Summary:
This project creates a continuous-time forecasting model by melding a Neural-ODE encoder with a Transformer decoder for irregular time-series prediction—a sophisticated, modern architecture integrating ODE‑RNNs and attention.
